name: CP2K libraries
description: Builds the libraries of CP2K 2026.2 with its checksum-verified toolchain, on the selected MPI, FFTW, ScaLAPACK and OpenBLAS. On the CUDA base CP2K needs gfortran, which the SDK's MPI has no Fortran modules for, so the toolchain builds a GNU stack with its own Open MPI for CP2K alone. ELPA, HDF5 and large-system libraries are optional; the cp2k Feature follows these choices.

gpuVersion.description: CP2K GPU target (kernels tuned for it; PTX is embedded, so newer GPUs JIT-compile); requires the CUDA base image. Empty builds the CPU version.

elpa.description: Use ELPA as the eigensolver; needs the elpa Feature, except on the CUDA base, where the toolchain builds it.

hdf5.description: Enable HDF5 output; needs the hdf5 Feature, except on the CUDA base, where the toolchain builds it.

largeSystems.description: Build COSMA, SpFFT, SpLA, SIRIUS (plane waves; needs hdf5), spglib and libvori with CP2K's toolchain. With gpuVersion, COSMA, SpFFT, SpLA and SIRIUS are GPU builds and CP2K offloads matrix products through SpLA.
